SilphCo_7F_Text_HaveMonForSavingUs:
Oh! Hi! You're not a ROCKET! You came to save us? Why, thank you!
I want you to have this POKéMON for saving us.
SilphCo_7F_Text_ObtainedLaprasFromEmploy: {PLAYER} obtained a LAPRAS from the SILPH employee!
SilphCo_7F_Text_ExplainLapras:
It's a LAPRAS. It's a very intelligent POKéMON.
We kept it in our lab, but it will be much better off with you.
I think you will be a good TRAINER for LAPRAS!
It's a good swimmer. It'll give you a lift across water!
SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketBossWentToBoardroo:
TEAM ROCKET's BOSS went to the boardroom!
Is our PRESIDENT okay? I'm worried.
SilphCo_7F_Text_OhNo: あ‥　もう　もてないぞ
SilphCo_7F_Text_SavedAtLast: たすかったよ　ありがと！
SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketsAfterMasterBall: TEAM ROCKET was after the MASTER BALL, which catches any POKéMON.
SilphCo_7F_Text_CanceledMasterBallProjec: We canceled the MASTER BALL project because of TEAM ROCKET.
SilphCo_7F_Text_BadIfTeamRocketTookOver: It would be bad if TEAM ROCKET took over SILPH or our POKéMON.
SilphCo_7F_Text_WowYouChasedOffTeamRocke:
Wow!
You chased off TEAM ROCKET all by yourself?
SilphCo_7F_Text_ReallyDangerousHere:
You! It's really dangerous here!
You came to save me? You can't!
SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3Intro: Uh-oh! I smell a little mouse!
SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle: You won't find my BOSS by just scurrying around!
SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaIntro:
Heheh!
You mistook me for a SILPH worker?
SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaPostBattle: Despite your age, you are a skilled TRAINER!
SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro: I am one of the four ROCKET BROTHERS!
SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: Doesn't matter. My brothers will repay the favor!
SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro: A child intruder? That must be you!
SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: Go on home before my BOSS gets ticked off!
SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalIntro:
{RIVAL}: Hahaha! I thought you'd turn up if I waited here!
I guess TEAM ROCKET slowed you down! Not that I care!
I saw you in SAFFRON, so I decided to see if you got better!
SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalDefeat: Oh, man! So, you are ready for BOSS ROCKET!
SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalVictory:
{RIVAL}“おまえなあ‥
こんな　うでまえじゃ まだまだ‥ いちにんまえ　とは　いえないぜ
SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalPostBattle:
Well, {PLAYER}! I'm moving on up and ahead!
By checking my POKéDEX, I'm starting to see what's strong and how they evolve!
Am I a genius or what?
I'm going to the POKéMON LEAGUE to boot out the ELITE FOUR.
I'll become the world's most powerful TRAINER!
{PLAYER}, well, good luck to you! Don't sweat it! Smell ya!
